description: Builder base images for config/rust-builder/Dockerfile. kickoff-build.py picks the newest base whose glibc is not newer than the node's (and whose libssl major matches when the app links openssl-sys). Preparation builds every base x target in advance with `python3 scripts/local-build.py prepare-images`, so the contest-day build skips rustup, apt and the cross linker. Pin a digest (rust:1-bookworm@sha256:...) after preparing if the tag must not move.
